newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb blasts French Finance Ministry building.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blasts French Finance Ministry building.

text.p: A bomb exploded outside a Finance Ministry building in the French Basque resort of Hendaye before dawn on Wednesday, causing heavy damage but no injuries, a government spokesman said.

No-one immediately claimed responsibility for the attack, but the spokesman said it appeared to be the work of the separatist guerrilla group Iparretarrak (Those of the North) which has been sporadically active in the region.
The device, which appeared to be a 13-kilo (28 lb) gas canister, was planted outside the building, a former hotel which was due to open in May as a holiday centre for Finance Ministry staff.

The attack followed a fresh wave of violence in Spain by the Basque separatist group ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom), which has killed around 800 people in three decades and is held responsible for six assassinations this year.
